teaser: A half-packed bag by the door, zipper open, waiting for one more decision. Life path 5 carries the longer name Movement and Challenge, and you carry it as an INFJ, someone built to read undercurrents and hold a private vision of how things ought to feel. One pulls toward motion and new rooms, the other toward depth and a steady thread of meaning. What's particular here is a person who can leave fast and still ask, halfway out the door, whether this exit means anything.
excerpt: A hand pauses on the clasp of a half-buttoned coat at the edge of a funeral reception, caught between staying for one more conversation and needing the air outside.
